entities.summary: White Serbia is a modern name for an early medieval Serbian homeland, which was initially written about under the name Boiki in the 10th-century Byzantine chronicle, De Administrando Imperio. This chronicle reports that a mass migration of unbaptized Serbs led by an unnamed leader set out from there prior to their arrival in the Balkans.
